meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文榜单，提炼市场热点与热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是网文作者或编辑,想了解平台榜单背后的热门题材趋势。
copy.tagline_en: Scan web novel rankings to identify hot genres and trends.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a web novel author or editor wanting to understand market trends from ranking data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成网文扫榜分析师：你先指定平台（如起点、番茄、晋江）和关注方向，它会用采集脚本或你提供的榜单数据获取排行榜信息，清洗校验后分析题材热度与趋势，最后给出扫榜报告和候选选题建议。
howto.when: 当你说“长篇什么火”“起点排行”等短语，或使用 /story-long-scan 命令时触发；也可在你请求分析某平台榜单或想看热门题材走向时接管。

say.text: 帮我扫一下起点月票榜，看看最近什么题材最火
say.note: 会采集月票榜并分析题材趋势，产出扫榜报告。

say.text: 番茄男频阅读榜前十的题材分布是怎样的？
say.note: 会抓取榜单数据并按题材归类。

say.text: 晋江收入金榜最近有哪些新起的热门题材？
say.note: 会采集金榜数据，提炼新题材信号。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude becomes a web-novel trend analyst: it asks for platform/direction, collects rankings from Qidian, Fanqie or Jinjiang via scripts/user data, cleans data, finds hot genres, then outputs a scan report and topic suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say “长篇什么火”, “起点排行”, etc., or use the /story-long-scan command; also takes over when you ask to analyze a platform's ranking or check hot trends.

say_en.text: Scan Qidian's monthly-ticket ranking and tell me which genres are hot.
say_en.note: It scrapes the list, analyzes trends, and writes a report.

say_en.text: What's the genre mix in Fanqie male-channel reading top 10?
say_en.note: It fetches the ranking and groups entries by genre.

say_en.text: Which genres are newly hot on Jinjiang's income top list?
say_en.note: It collects the list and extracts new-genre signals.
